Lina (Docs): Hey team — pushed a small PR that adds a compact invoke example + telemetry note for function-calling docs. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4523
Aj (Eng): thanks, will skim in a bit. Does it cover the retry header telemetry we discussed?
Lina (Docs): short version: adds this note under 'observability' and an SDK snippet showing how to attach request_id and latency tags. Example is intentionally minimal.
Taylor (SDK): can you paste the snippet here? quick check for idiomatic usage.
Lina (Docs): sure — here's the snippet in the PR:
```js
// attach telemetry to an invoke call
const resp = await client.invoke({
  model: 'redwood-std-1',
  input: 'summarize...',
  meta: { request_id: 'req-1234', latency_ms: 0 } // telemetry-friendly field
});
```
Sam (Product): is meta a supported field in our public SDK? last I checked we had metadata but different shape. we shouldn't document internal fields.
Aj (Eng): good point. SDK currently forwards a `metadata` object, not `meta`. docs should match. Taylor: can you confirm the right field name and whether we should encourage request_id usage?
Taylor (SDK): confirm: public SDK takes `metadata` (object). we recommend `metadata.request_id` and `metadata.metrics` for telemetry. I'll paste the recommended snippet shortly.
docs-bot: CI passed on PR #4523 :white_check_mark:
Lina (Docs): thanks. I'll update the example to use `metadata` instead. Also adding a one-line note: "Do not rely on internal telemetry fields; use metadata.* and the observability hooks."
Taylor (SDK): suggested snippet:
```js
// recommended pattern
const resp = await client.invoke({
  model: 'redwood-std-1',
  input: 'summarize...',
  metadata: { request_id: 'req-1234', metrics: { client_latency_ms: 120 } }
});
```
Aj (Eng): looks good. small nit: use snake_case in docs examples? Our telemetry service expects `client_latency_ms` (snake_case) per the contract. We should be explicit.
Lina (Docs): ok switching to snake_case in the snippet. Also found two broken links in the PR: the observability cross-link pointed to /guides/observability-old which 404s. Replaced with /console/observability.
Sam (Product): awesome. can we add a one-line migration note for customers on Dedicated: "If you're routing to a custom telemetry endpoint, map metadata.request_id to your existing request id field."
Lina (Docs): added that as a small callout.
Taylor (SDK): one last ask — include a tiny parse example showing how to read the request_id from the response envelope for server-side correlation. e.g.:
```js
// extract correlation id from response envelope
const correlation = resp?.envelope?.metadata?.request_id || resp?.metadata?.request_id;
```
Aj (Eng): that `.envelope` fallback is fine as a migration shim but maybe mark as deprecated pattern.
Lina (Docs): will add "deprecated shim" note. Planning to merge once I update the snippet and fix the links. Anyone object to merge after those updates?
Taylor (SDK): nope, go for it after updates.
Sam (Product): +1
Aj (Eng): +1
Lina (Docs): great — thanks all. I'll push changes and ping when done. :thumbsup:
